attackers_goals: Unusual processes may be executed for various purposes, including exfiltration, lateral movement, etc.
description: A user executed a living-off-the-land binary (LOLBIN) process that is unusual for this user. This may be indicative of a compromised account.
investigative_actions: Investigate the process that was executed to determine if it was used for legitimate purposes or malicious activity.
name: Rare LOLBIN Process Execution by User
